dedupe_keys.name: building material stocks and embodied carbon yangtze river delta and greater bay area 2000 to 2020

description: This collection quantifies building material stocks and the embodied carbon emissions of construction materials for two Chinese urban agglomerations, the Yangtze River Delta and the Greater Bay Area, from 2000 to 2020, and is described in a Scientific Data article of June 2025 by authors at Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology and elsewhere. It has 26 core xlsx tables and about 133 million records: city totals and shares by 11 construction materials for material stock and embodied carbon for 38 cities (8,778 records each), and 500 m by 500 m gridded material stock and embodied carbon, in total and per material (aluminium, asphalt, brick, cement, copper, glass, gravel, lime, sand, steel, timber and others), about 5.5 million records per layer. Coverage: 38 cities in eastern and southern China. Access: free Figshare download. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: stocks are modelled from building areas and material intensity coefficients, not surveyed, and the grid is coarse for single buildings. Simulation uses: urban material flow, circular construction and embodied carbon scenario models. Related records: the 10 m material stock maps and the GBDB CarbEnMats database.
